preview.tournamentOverview: Bellerive Country Club hosts the BMW Championship with a course profile that heavily rewards off-the-tee play. SG OTT carries the highest weight at 1%, followed by SG Total at 3%, while SG PUT and SG APP are secondary factors. This is the second leg of the FedExCup Playoffs, where top-30 players advance to the Tour Championship and the field is limited to the top 50 in the standings.
preview.modelExplainer: The model places 1% weight on SG OTT and 3% on SG Total, making driving distance and overall ball-striking the primary inputs. SG PUT 4%) and SG APP 1%) are secondary, while driving accuracy 0%) and bogey avoidance 0%) are minimal factors. This weighting favors players who gain strokes off the tee and post strong total strokes-gained numbers over pure accuracy or scrambling.
preview.pickApproach: Tier 1 targets players with elite SG OTT plus strong SG Total rankings, led by Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy. Tier 2 looks for SG PUT outliers who still clear a baseline SG Total threshold, such as Jake Knapp and Jacob Bridgeman. Tier 3 includes SG APP standouts like Collin Morikawa and Matt Fitzpatrick who fit the course profile despite lower overall rankings.
